title: Amarnath Yatra 2026 to Begin on July 3, Weather Conditions to be Checked
summary: The Amarnath Yatra 2026 is set to begin on July 3. The yatra will take place amidst heavy rainfall and snowfall in the region. The Indian government has advised pilgrims to carry essential items such as food, water, and first aid kits. The yatra's success depends on the weather conditions, which are expected to be challenging.
summary_points: The Amarnath Yatra 2026 is scheduled to begin on July 3.
Heavy rainfall and snowfall are expected in the region where the yatra will take place.
Pilgrims have been advised to carry essential items such as food, water, and first aid kits.
The success of the yatra depends on the weather conditions, which are expected to be challenging.
The Indian government has taken necessary precautions to ensure the safety of pilgrims.
